_comment: Files in public/ that may differ from v1 (golden rule 1). public/js/** is v2-only and never compared. kind 'rewire': the ONLY change allowed is fetch( → AO_API.fetch( at v1 API call sites — checked by reversing it and comparing to v1 byte-for-byte. kind 'free': any change, needs a reason.

script.js.reason: getEvents banner + getOrder lookup go through public/js/api.js (Phase 2)

event-order.html.reason: registerInterest, getEvents, createEventOrder go through public/js/api.js (Phase 2)

order.html.reason: v1's Google Form iframe replaced by Artisan Oven's own order form (same questions, v1 styling); Google preconnects removed (Louis: no Google anywhere)
